objective: Compare Bank layouts while fixing expert-to-device/partition ownership

dataset_split.profile: disjoint requests used only to estimate page heat/co-access
dataset_split.evaluation: later disjoint requests; no future accesses used for placement
dataset_split.required_repeats: multiple arrival seeds and at least steady/Poisson/bursty modes

controls.name: static_xor_interleave
controls.definition: owner-independent address-bit XOR/interleave; same transform for profile and evaluation

controls.name: heat_balance
controls.definition: greedy per-partition assignment by descending profile bytes/accesses to the least-loaded feasible Bank

controls.name: cross_user_time_weighted_coaccess
controls.definition: per-partition capacitated assignment that penalizes placing distinct pages with high cross-user temporal-overlap score on the same Bank

reported_metrics: represented and remote NoC bytes plus peak-link load
runtime migration bytes (must be zero for the static design)

separate_attribution.same_page_multiple_users: not addressable by relocation alone; requires replication, striping, or scheduling

claim_gate: No benefit claim until all four controls complete on held-out evaluation requests and the end-to-end paired delta is stable across seeds.
